text:
Liam (docs): Quick sync 1: we need a tiny migration note for the error-ref doc: customers upgrading SDK v1 -> v2 should swap their ad-hoc 429 handlers to use `retryUtils.trimAndRetry`. Can someone produce a one-paragraph explanation + 2-line snippet?

Rhea (sdk): I can do that. Proposal: show message-level trimming + honoring Retry-After header. Keep it language-agnostic then give JS/py mini snippets.

Diego (eng-runtime): +1. Also add a short operator note: runtime now sets `x-partial-ok: 1` when we return partial content; callers should log it and reconcile state before retry.

Liam (docs): Good catch. We should explicitly tell customers NOT to drop system prompts during trimming. Add that as a bold callout.

Nina (product): Can we include a migration risk matrix? Just two rows: "stateful side effects" and "stateless chat UI" with recommended trim severity. Tiny table or bullet pair.

Rhea (sdk): I'll draft the text: two bullets summarizing risk and example thresholds (e.g., conservative: drop only assistant/user pairs up to 3; aggressive: drop oldest until token <= target). Then add JS + Python snippets under 12 lines each.

Liam (docs): Also include the SDK util link and note that older customers using raw HTTP should still follow the same pattern.

Rhea (sdk): Draft pushed to fork: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1509. Snippet preview in PR description.

ci-bot: CI queued for PR #1509 1: docs lint + snippet-lint.

Diego (eng-runtime): One more runtime note: `Retry-After` may be fractional; treat <1s as ignore. Also mention that we set `x-rw-retry-suggest: <mode>` in some throttling cases.

Liam (docs): Perfect. I'll add a short "how we tested this" section: unit test for trimming util + manual smoke with chat replay. Keeps it concrete.

Rhea (sdk): Updated PR with tests link and language-agnostic pseudocode. Requesting reviews from @Diego and @Nina.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #1509 1: lint OK, snippet-sanity OK.

Diego (eng-runtime): Reviewed and approved. Left a tiny nit to prefer `maxRetries=3` in examples.

Nina (product): Approved. Added a short migration note to the release checklist.

Rhea (sdk): Merged into main and backported to `stable-2.x`. Will follow up to add the longer example to SDK README if folks want it.

Liam (docs): Merged 1: will include the migration blurb in the weekly docs digest. Thanks everyone! :tada:
